questions.question: On 2026-01-02, how many signals did ingestion make from one chunk at most?
questions.reference: Fifty: on 2026-01-02 ingest_chunk stopped at MAX_SIGNALS, which was 50. It became 100 the next day.

questions.question: What was the deliverables page called on 2026-01-03?
questions.reference: Deliverable records; it was renamed Deliverables on 2026-01-04.

questions.question: What changed in signal ingestion between 2026-01-02 and 2026-01-04?
questions.reference: MAX_SIGNALS went from 50 to 100, save_signal in store.py began keeping each signal in the in-memory SIGNALS list, and the note that long chunks are truncated was removed.
